{{Quote|THE MANDALORIANS HAVE RETRACTED THEIR EFFLUX BAFFLES IN ORDER TO PURSUE.|[[Ninette]], to [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Tahiri Veila]].|<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>}}
An '''efflux baffle''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] component used to mask the vessel's exhaust. When deployed, efflux baffles made a starship harder for others to detect, at the cost of reduced speed and maneuverability. In [[45 ABY]], ''[[Bes'uliik]]'' [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] employed by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] working for the corporation [[Galactic Exploitation Technologies]] in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]] were equipped with efflux baffles.<ref name="Crucible" />
{{Tech-stub}}
 
==Behind the scenes==
Efflux baffles appeared in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
